༄༅/ /mgon po 'bri gung pa'i gdung rabs dang gdan sar byon tshul mdor bsdus dper brjod dang bcas pa pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mgon po 'bri gung pa'i gdung rabs dang gdan sar byon tshul mdor bsdus dper brjod dang bcas pa pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

bho ṣan+tu sarba gu ru masta kā laṅkā ra nā tha tsa ma rī rā tri na mo nā ma// gangs ris yongs bzlums zlum po'i khyim du mi sbyin rgyu ba'i do ra ru// yid bzang nā rā ya ṇaḥl sogs ku sa ma tshogs ke sa rar// gang zhig zhabs sor sor mo'i dbang phyug 'phrog byed gang der rab brtse ba// sa gsum bsam gtan ma rnams gzhom byed srid mig dam pas 'gro 'di srungs// thun mtshams ka dam+ba can mdangs 'gog mtshan dpes sgeg pa'i brjid chags sku/ /mkhyen bzang ye shes dpal ldan mtshon gyis 'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri bo bsnyil// drang nges legs bshad nga ro'i sgra yis rmongs pa'i ri dwags mthar 'dzin byed// mi 'phrog dpa' bo 'jam mgon khro bos rtag par bdag gi bshes mdzod cig /gna' dus mkhas rlom spyi brtol phal gyi nyes bshad srin bu'i 'od snang la// rmongs pa'i yi dwags rgyu 'joms re ba'i brtul zhugs de ko ring dor la// don bzang me yis sa bon dngos dpal gos kyi srad bur rab dngar ba// shes ldan kho bos legs par sbyin gyis mngan bgrang spongs la spyi bor longs// gru 'dzin dgyes sprul nags gnas rgyal byed dang*// myur skyob ma dngos rak+ṣa sī rol par// gdong drug rus las zla bral 'gru yi rigs/ /'ga' 'das 'gru rje lha dbang thod dkar sras// stag rgan por gyur pa'i mtshan 'gru rgan se bo zhes grags so// rgod ces 'bod de la bu bdun btsas// de dag 'byor pas dregs pa'i rang rtsal gyis// yab kyi na bza' sram 'phying rlung khyer ba// mtsho la rgyu ba'i ra mdar song ba'i tshe| |'chi bdag dug can kha ru bu bdun 'das// stag rgod rgan por son kyang slar bshos par// gnas kyi bla dwags nyi ma dkar nag khrar| |btags pa'i bu gsum byung ba'i dkar po'i sras// dpa' bo so gad ya gad ma gad gsum// che ba so gad rang lo nyi shu'i steng*// sbom ra'i lha mgul khrus kyi rdzing bu'i ngogs// tshogs bzang bu mo dag dang mnyam rol ba'i// sras mchog skyu ra gnam sbyin dkar po zhes// sa gsum snyan grags gdugs dkar g.yo 'di dpen/

/mkha' nas skyur tshe nor 'dzin steng lhung bas// ltag g.yon sor dgu pa ces grags rnga sgrog /de sras skyu ra yar dang de sras bzang*// de sras 'brom zhes de yi sras zung ni// tshul khrims rgya mtsho g.yung drung rgya mtshor grags// de tshe gnyen gnyan sngags 'chang jo dpal dang*// brin bza' dar 'jam las 'khrungs chos kyi sgrol| |mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug de ko tsar stod kyi// grong khyer tsong ngur tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i khab// bzhes pa'i sras bzhi nam mkha' dbang phyug dang*// dpe ka dbang rgyal na 'gags bsod nams dpal// ka thung gru bzhi zhes grags dpe dbang sras// mkhan po dar ma dkon mchog rat+na dang*// btsun pa 'bar dang rnal 'byor rdo rje rgyal// rim pas dang po gcen yin tha ma gcung*// rnal 'byor rdor rgyal rak+shi btsun ma'i sras// thub dbang nā gardzu na nyid sprul pa// chu mo gtsang byed lo la 'jig rten mgon// rat+na shrī zhes thams cad gzigs 'di bltams// gzhon nu'i mtshan ni rdo rje dpal zhes grags// lo drug 'bri klog mthar son klung mo cher// 'khor 'das chos kun me long nang ltar gzigs// nyer lnga'i lo la phag mo gru ru byon// bde gshegs rdor rgyal zhabs 'bring lo gnyis bzhugs// dam pa de nyid mya ngan 'das pa'i tshe// gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga thugs ka nas// thon te nyid kyi thugs kar thim pa ni// der 'khod lus can kun gyis tshad grub mthong*// e chung phug tu lo drug mnyam par bzhag /gtsug tor 'phags sogs mtshan dpe rdzogs par byon// sum cu rtsa lnga me mo gnyis skyes lor// sum thog zhang gis chos 'dul mkhan po dang*// rtsi lung pa yis las kyi slob dpon mdzad// mnyal pa 'dul 'dzin la sogs 'dus khrod du// chig rdzogs bye smra'i lugs kyi brtul zhugs mnos// sum cu rtsa bdun sa mo sgra ldan lo// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod der byon nas// nor ldan rdul snyed grangs ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs/

/bag ldan 'khor gyi dbus su 'khor lo gsum// yongs dag gsung dbyangs drug cu'i nga ro yis// kun gyi 'khor mtha' ming gi lhag mar byas// dngos kyis 'dul ba'i gdul bya rab rdzogs shing*// le lo can rnams brtson 'grus lam zhugs phyir// don lnga me mo nags tshal dga' ba'i lor// sprul pa'i snang ba chos nyid zhi bar bsdus// rgyal bas 'od srung che la thub pa'i bstan// gtad pa ji bzhin dam pa'i bstan pa yang*// shing pho bdun ldan lor 'khrungs gu ra ba// mkhan chen gang de'i gdan sar lo bzhi bzhugs// rje yi khu bo dkon mchog rat+na'i sras// a grags zhes bod de sras gsum bltams pa'i// che ba dbon chen bsod nams grags pa yis// seng ge'i khri la bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i bar// thub bstan nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal bar mdzad// de rjes spyan snga kīrti a ka ras/ yab sras gdan sa chab mnyam spel zhes gleng*// de 'og til+li'i rnam sprul rdo rje grags// gang de rgya mtsho skyes lor sku 'khrungs shing*/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum bar du tshogs pa bskyangs// rgya nag stong khun dug thang rgyal po yis/ /karma pak+shi byin za'i zhugs bzhes tshe// mdun gyi mkhar byon dbugs dbyung 'jigs las sgrol// chung ba dpon rgyud seng ge zhes bya la// sras lnga che ba brtse can sprul pa ni// thog kha bar grags rat+na singha'i mtshan// me pho nor skyong lor 'khrungs seṅge'i khrir// lo bdun bzhugs shing bstan pa'i sgron me sbar// de 'og rdo rje grags dang a nu rgyal// de 'og mtshams bcad grags pa bsod nams zhes// sa pho nor srung lor 'khrungs gdan sa cher// lo gsum bzhugs tshe snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo// de rjes jo gnubs rdo rje ye shes zhes// sa glang lor 'khrungs gdan sa lo drug bzhugs// de tshe sum rtsen dpal 'phrog byang chub gling// ma rungs 'tshe bas za phod zhugs su sbyangs// dug 'dzin lo la jo gnubs spyugs zhes smra// mtshams bcad grags pa'i gcung po dkon mchog che// a nu rgyal sras chen po bsod rdor mtshan// chung ba dpon rgyud rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes// de sras che ba sa ra ha'i sprul pa// 'bru mang lo la dam pa'i snang brnyan bltams// gang 'di'i mtshan dkar rdo rje rin chen zhes// bla dwags tsam du bcu gnyis pa zhes grags// sgrub brgyud bsti gnas dpal gyi byang chub gling*// dregs byed tshogs kyis nyams par bgyis rnams kyang*| |rgyal ba mchog 'di'i thugs rje'i zlos gar gyis// gna' dus zil gyis gnon pa'i dpal 'bar ba// 'di ko dam pa de las gzhan su zhig

/rnam 'gyur nas ni nyi ma'i lo yi bar// rgyal ba gnyis pa 'dis ni bstan pa spel// de 'og shing pho marka ṭa yi lor// legs 'khrungs rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// zla med bsngags pa'i lung bstan bgrang yas bdag /rig 'dzin de'i sprul nyer brgyad rdor rgyal zhes// seng ge'i khri la lo drug bstan pa spel// de 'og lho pa ga ya shrī zhes grags// chung ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes bya'i sras// gcen po chu mo mang skyes lor bltams pa// nyer gnyis chos kyi rgyal po zhes grags te// bcu bdun lo la gdan sar dbang bskur zhing*// bco brgyad lon tshe gdan sa sa skya ru// phar tshad gzhung lugs 'chad rtsod legs bshad kyi// skal ngan rtog ge'i tshogs rnams pham mdzad cing*// bstan pa'i sgron mes sa gsum snang bar mdzad| |tsong kha'i yul 'ongs blo bzang grags pa sogs// mkhas grub bgrang yas slob mas sa steng khyab// bstan pa'i bdag po lo mang nyid du mdzad// 'di yi gcung po rdo rje dpal gyi sras// me yi mgrin pa'i lo la khyod sku bltams// so dgu'i lo la seng khrir dbang bskur zhing*// gong ma rgyal pos ti shrī'i lung gis bsngags// mtshan dngos don grub rgyal po zhes grags pas// bstan pa gsal zhing dam chos dbyar rnga sgrog /'on kyang gdung rabs gser gyi phreng ba nyid// cung zad phra bas chos nyid rol pa'i rtsal// gang 'dul thabs kyis shes rab khab bzhes pa'i// sras ni spu rangs lo la sku bltams te// zla ba phyed gnyis tshogs dang gdan sa bskyangs// mtshan dkar rin chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan zhes// de tshe 'khrug long tshogs kyis thugs phyung ste// rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar bros te phebs// de yi mtshan yang bdag po wang zhes grags// 'chi med mchog grub da lta'ang bzhugs zhes gleng*| |'dis kyang chos srid zung du bstan bskyangs pa'i// sras ni chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang zhes// lcags mo nags tshal dga' ba'i lo la 'khrungs// bcu drug steng du gdan sa'i khur chen bsnams// gang 'dis lugs zung bstan pa'i ba dan g.yo// 'di sras gcen po wang mtshan mkhar thogs pa// gcung ni sa mo sna ring lor bltams pa// gang mtshan rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes// bla dwags mtshan du bco lnga pa zhes brjod/

/'dis kyang seng ge'i khri dang rgyal po'i srid// zung du spel ba'i sras ni rnam gsum ste// che ba sgom pa rin chen rnam rgyal zhes// phag mo rtse ru rigs sras spel phyir byon// de 'og dam pa kun dga' mtshan dkar can// rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nyid| |ma 'ongs dus su 'byon par nyid lung bstan// gang khyod sngon dus klu rigs sgron ma ste// lha yul ston pa dpa' bo rtsal rdzogs dang*// lha min gnas su mtshon can rtsal rdzogs zhes| |mi yul ston pa ting 'dzin rgyal po dang*// yi dwags gnas su ston pa me tog rdzogs// byol song gnas su gnyen bzang byed po ste// dmyal ba'i gnas su bsil byed 'od 'phro zhes| |'gro drug gnas su sprul pas de don mdzad// de 'og ston pa 'od zer mtha' yas zhes// de 'das bdag cag ston pa'i spyan snga ru// sku yi sprul pa byang sems gsal mchog dang*| |gsung sprul li tsa dri ma med par grags/ /thugs sprul kun dga' bor gyur bka' bsdu mdzad/ /de 'og sku dngos 'phags pa klu sgrub ces/ /de yi sku sprul ḍoṃ bhi he ru kaḥ |gsung sprul nus ldan blo gros rtsal zhes dang*// thugs kyi sprul pa bram ze sa ra ha// yon tan sprul pa dzi na byang chub dang*// 'phrin las sprul pa gsung byed bden smra zhes| |sprul pa lngar bcas 'phags yul bstan pa spel// de 'og bod du srong btsan sgam po dang*// khri srong lde'u btsan khri gtsug ral can sogs// sprul pa du mas 'gro gang bde bar khrid| |de 'og 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po zhes/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs 'dir 'bar/ /slar yang ma 'ongs dus su sprul pa ni/ /'byung tshul gser khang sgo bcad lung bstan las/ /chos dus gang zag rdzas rtags mi 'gyur bzhi// gsal bar gyur tshe 'byon par zhal 'ches phyir// rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can gang de nyid// pra ti ta yi lo la sku bltams shing*/

/bcu bdun lo la thub pa'i brtul zhugs mnos/ /bco brgyad bzhes tshe sku yi bkod pa ni// gcig dang du ma la sogs cho 'phrul bstan// nyi shu bzhes tshe rgyal tshab dbang bskur zhing*/ /gdan sar phebs te bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad/ /bgrang yas 'gro la phan bde'i lam bstan nas// sgra ldan lo la zhing gzhan 'dul phyir gshegs| |gcung po chos rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/ /'phags pa'i yul du hūm̐ chen ka ra nyid/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i spyan sngar lha rigs sras// sad na legs dang slob dpon nam mkha' snying*/ /sku yi bkod pa zung bstan 'gro rnams srung*/ /skyob pa'i spyan sngar shes rab 'byung gnas te/ /nyer brgyad mtshan dang rdor rin la sogs pa/ /sprul pa 'ga' yi tha mar slar gshegs pa/ /sa khams lnga ldan mig gi thos pa'i lor/ /gang sku dge mtshan dang bcas dge bar btsas/ /bcu gsum lo la 'phags mas rjes su bzung*/ /dam pa mang po'i zhabs rdul rab bsten nas/ /bcu phrag rig pa bka' dang bstan bcos sogs/ /shes bya'i chos kun thams cad brnyes par mdzad/ /nyi shu'i lo la paṇa chen sdom rgyun las/ /bye smra'i brtul zhugs khrims gtsang mnga' dbang phyug /seng chen khri la rgyal tshab mnga' gsol bgyis/ /nyer drug bzhes tshe badz+ra nā tha'i drung*/ /mtshungs med 'ja' lus rlung gi gdams pa gsan/ /sa pho nor skyong gnam lor shar ba yi// sum cu bzhes tshe gzhu stod gter sgrom nas// zab gter dgongs pa yang zab bzhes mdzad cing*/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i bdag po nyid du gyur// me mo rkang sbas zhe dgu'i lor bab tshe/ /rig 'dzin snga 'gyur bstan pa'i bdag po 'di/ /mngon dgar rgyal ba klong yangs mtshan du gshegs/ /sgom pa rin chen rnam par rgyal ba'i sras/ /sgom pa byams pa rin chen rnam rgyal zhes/ /de sras che ba rin chen rnam rgyal nyid/ /gdan sar dbang bskur 'dus sde thabs kyis bskyangs/ /'bring po paṇa chen dpal gyi rgya mtsho zhes/

/gdan sar phebs shing sgrub brgyud bstan pa mchog |nges don dam pa'i chos kyis gsal bar mdzad/ /chung ba gcung gi mtshan 'dzin gang de'i sras/ /gcen po phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes bya yis/ /seng ge'i khri la bsgyings shing lugs gnyis mdzad/ /gcung po karma mi pham dbang rgyal po/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal sras ni byā gh+ra'i lor// 'khrungs pa mi pham rin chen chos kyi rgyal/ /de sras gcen po da lta'i skyid phug pa/ /gcung ni sku skyes lnga par gshegs pa ste/ /sa mo mche ba'i lus can gnam lo'i tshe// skyid phug chos rje'i sras shig bltams so lo/ /rig 'dzin chen po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi/ /chos dang srid kyi bstan pa cher spel ba'i/ /rigs sras dam pa mthong thos bder grol ba/ /gang 'di sngon dus rab rtsal gtsug lag 'dzin/ /gung btsan ā kar a ka ra ma ti ma ti de ba kar de wa ā ka ra/ /rgyal sras lha rje sangs rgyas bla ma dang*/ /nyi ma seng ge o rgyan gling pa sogs| |gang 'dul der ston skye ba 'ga' yi mthar/ /pra sa ga zhes gnam lor dbang bsgyur tshe/ /phun tshogs dpag yas ltas dang bcas te bltams/ /bcu gnyis lon tshe 'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyal/ /phyag rgya zil gnon dang mjal grub pa brnyes/ /gang de rab tu byung ba'i mtshan dkar ni/ /chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po| |nges don phyag rgya che ba brtson sgom tshe/ /sgom med chen po'i rtogs pa mngon du mdzad/ /gang zhig log rtog brtas pa'i go 'byed ngogs/ /ma rungs sgrog byed du ma rab bgros nas/ /skad ngan sgra 'byin phyogs brgyar rab sgrog cing*/ /skyo sngogs sdang byed spro sems de ko rnams/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i dri gzhon rab spros nas/ /log byed tshogs rnams rmeg med mthar phyung ste/ /rgya mtsho skyes lor dpal gyi seṅge'i khrir/ /mngon par dbang bskur thub bstan snang ba'i bdag /mi mthun nam mkha'i ta ma las bsgribs pa/

/thugs rje dri yi gzhon pas bsal mdzad nas/ /'gro kun bde ba'i sa ru dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /le lo can 'dul rdo rje'i sku gshegs nas/ /mya ngan 'da' ba dus gsum rgyal kun gyi/ /mdzad pa'i rtse mo yin phyir der dgongs nas/ /nga drug dge byed lo la zhing gzhan gshegs/ /rje 'dis lugs gnyis bstan pa rab bdo ba'i| |sras bzhi che ba grub pa'i dbang phyug ni/ /dngos po'i lo la dge mtshan dang bcas bltams/ /bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes pa'i mtshan dkar ba dan g.yo/ /rtsa dgu'i lo la seṅge'i khrir phebs nas/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin dga' ston mdzad/ /dam pa 'di ni nā ro ta pa yi/ /sprul pa yin zhes sa gsum grags rnga brdungs/ /de 'og shing khams yal ga'i ri dwags lor/ /legs bltams zhwa dmar drug pa thams cad mkhyen/ /gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug ces mtshan grags/ /de 'og rnam 'gyur lo la legs bltams pa/ /'brom ston rgyal ba'i mtshan slar sprul pa ni/ /zhing 'dir dkon mchog rat+na zhes su grags// nyer drug lo la gdan sar dbang bskur zhing*// thub bstan rab brnyes dbyar rnga'i grags pa sgrog /maṅga'i mtshan gyis chos srid zung bskyangs pa'i// rigs sras lcags pho lag ldan lor 'khrungs pa'i/ /mtshan dkar bstan pa'i nor bu rigs sngags 'chang*/ /grub pa'i brtul zhugs mchog la dbang bsgyur kyang*/ /nyer bzhi mig dmar lo la bde bar gshegs/ /sras bzhi'i tha chung 'di rtsom byed po ni/ /myos byed lor skyes chung nas dge la bkol/ /bod chen yul gyi 'gro la dge lam bstan// mu tig btsad po'i skye bar khas 'che zhing*/ /rigs lam bcu dang mdo rgyud bstan bcos sogs/ /zab mo'i legs bshad tshogs la blo phyogs shing*/ /bskyed rdzogs nyams len rang so tshud bgyid nas/ /'khor 'das chos kun mnyam rol sems su rtogs/ /'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon mchog grub cing*/

/snga 'gyur bstan pa'i phyogs su yid phyogs pa/ /sgrub brgyud snying po rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i/ /bstan pa chos srid zung gis spel sems pa'i/ /lhag bsam rnam dag dang bcas bder 'tsho ba/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje'i snang byed des bskyangs pa'i/ /bdag blo mtsho skyes lang tsho cher spa ba'i/ /legs bshad bā dhu'i zil mngar dpyid smin pas/ /blo ldan sbrang rtsi skyong rnams tshim gyur cig |smras pa/ /rgyal ba kun yab 'phags mchog seng ge rtsen/ /ye shes dbyings nas thugs rje'i chu 'thung gis/ /bdag blo'i dri bzang khang pa rab bdo ba'i// bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyid do// kye ma/ phyogs 'dir gna' dus ngag gi mtshon can mkhas pa du ma'i legs bshad kyis// yang dag rtogs pa'i kau bi da ra gdan rim gsal byed gang phyes pa// de kun deng sang nub la nye tshe dregs ldan mchod sbyin dgra tshogs kyis/ /log par rtog pa'i rang 'dod mngon bgrangs yid mos bcom la ma thug gam// de tshe blo can rgan las thob/ /khros te legs bshad rtsa brgyad las/ /ma rungs gzhu rgyal dpung gi tshogs/ /rmeg med bcom 'di kye ma mtshar/ /deng sang mkhas par rlom pa'i snying sprul po/ /'ga' 'ga' lung rigs gzhung lugs ring spangs nas/ /rmi lam nyams snang mkha' 'gros zer ro lo/ /rgyud gzhung paṇa grub dgongs pa ltag chod pa/ /de ko g.yar tsha bral ba'i lus can de/ /dregs pa'i bcom skyungs bag yod byed re ran/ /kha cig rang 'dod log par zhen pa legs bshad yin rlom tshig gi mda'/ /'brel med ca co yi ge'i gnam rur drangs nas gzhan la rdeg gzab tshe/ /pha rol 'ben la bsnun 'dod sems kyang ma dag 'chal ba'i nyon mongs des// khyod rgyud bsregs nas bstir med 'tshed las gzhan la gnod pa cang mchis sam/ /'di bkod gdan rabs mdog bzang dngos/ /legs bshad mtsho skyes sha lu dkar// tshar du dngar ba'i phreng ba 'di/

/blo ldan yod na thod bcings 'os/ /gzu bor gnas pa'i shes ldan blos/ /legs bshad zur brgyad dod pa dag /smras tshe skyo sngogs 'di ko zhes| |rmongs rnams ku cos sa steng gang*/ /mkhris nad kyis gtses mig lam dung dang shel/ /ser por mthong ltar ma rtogs log rtog gis/ /sngon rabs mdzangs pa'i legs bshad khyad gsod pa'i/ /rang 'dod 'khrul ba'i gtam dang 'di mi mnyam/ /tshul 'di shes ldan rnams kyis rtogs sla yang*/ /blun po dad pa'i rjes 'brang kha cig gis| |go dka' 'gyur dogs me tog phreng spel gyi/ /dper brjod dang bcas mthong shes 'di sbyar ro/ /'di brtsams pa las byung ba yi/ /dung ltar dkar ba'i dges mtshon pa/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags yod dge/ /byang chub thob phyir bsngo bar bgyi/ /dge tshogs de ko khe dang grags/ /lo 'dod phyir du bdag mi bsngo// kha cig lo 'dod chos brgyad kyi/ /dge bar rlom rnams sha thang ngo*/ /zhes gdan sa dang gdung rabs kyi rtsa tshigs mdor bsdus pa pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yang nyams snang dang rmi lam lung bstan dang rang bzo'i spyi brtol la legs bshad re ba'i gya tshom dang*/ rang gis ma rtogs kyang snga ma'i yig cha la gzhi tsam byas pa'i rang gi zhe 'dod kyis gzhan khyad du gsod pa'i bsam pas/ lo 'dod khe grags kyis zur za dmyal bar 'gro ba'i las gsog pa sogs deng sang gi mkhas rlom phal cher gyis legs bshad rtsom tshul gyi brtul zhugs de lta bu rgyang du bsrings nas/ sngon gyi yig cha khungs thub dang rang gi shes tshod rnams go bde ba'i tshig las/ gzhan pa'i sgra dang mngon brjod snyan ngag sdeb sbyor gyi spros pa skabs 'dir dor nas shes ldan rnams la phan pa'i blos/ 'bri gung pa gsang ba sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas sa sbrul gro bzhin can gyi zla ba snga ma'i dkar cha rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la gtsug lag lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po pho brang bkra shis tshugs su mgyogs par sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu//
